item.title: [Bug] Terminal PATH duplicate injection - same paths injected multiple times with different slash formats
item.body:
## Bug Description

When opening a terminal in Trae, the same tool paths are injected into PATH multiple times with different formats (double backslashes vs single backslashes), causing PATH duplication.

## Environment

- **Trae Version:** 2.3.23677
- **OS:** Windows 10/11
- **Shell:** PowerShell

## Current Behavior

When opening a terminal, PATH contains duplicate entries:

`
1. D:\\apps\\nvm\\v24.9.0          (double backslash)
2. c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current  (double backslash)
3. c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\3cf0187e\\versions\\node\\current  (double backslash)
4. c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current  (double backslash)
5. D:\apps\nvm\v24.9.0            (single backslash - DUPLICATE)
6. c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current    (single backslash - DUPLICATE)
7. c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\3cf0187e\versions\node\current  (single backslash - DUPLICATE)
8. c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current  (single backslash - DUPLICATE)
9-14. More duplicates with different workspace IDs (cdc9e9bd)
`

**Total PATH entries:** 40 (should be ~26)
**Duplicate entries:** 14

## Expected Behavior

Each tool path should only appear once in PATH, with consistent path format.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open Trae IDE (v2.3.23677)
2. Open integrated terminal (PowerShell)
3. Run: (D:\\apps\\nvm\\v24.9.0;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\3cf0187e\\versions\\node\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current;D:\apps\nvm\v24.9.0;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\3cf0187e\versions\node\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\cdc9e9bd\\versions\\node\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\cdc9e9bd\versions\node\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current;C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Oracle\Java\java8path;C:\Windows\system32;C:\Windows;C:\Windows\System32\Wbem;C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0;C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH;C:\Program Files\dotnet;D:\apps\java\jdk-21\bin;D:\apps\apache-maven-3.9.6\bin;D:\apps\mingw64\bin;C:\Program Files\Tailscale\;C:\Users\86150\.local\bin;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Programs\oh-my-posh\bin;D:\apps\nvm4w\nodejs;D:\apps\nvm;D:\apps\python312;D:\apps\python312\Scripts;D:\apps\Git\cmd;C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\;C:\Program Files\Go\bin;C:\Users\86150\.cargo\bin;C:\Users\86150\scoop\shims;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\pnpm;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Google.PlatformTools_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\platform-tools;D:\apps\nssm-2.24\win64 -split ';').Count
4. Observe duplicate entries

## Root Cause Analysis

The shell integration script appears to:
1. Inject paths multiple times (possibly once per workspace)
2. Use inconsistent path formats (double vs single backslashes)
3. Not check for existing entries before injection

## Workaround

Currently using a PowerShell function to deduplicate PATH on startup:

`powershell
function Optimize-Path {
     = D:\\apps\\nvm\\v24.9.0;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\3cf0187e\\versions\\node\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current;D:\apps\nvm\v24.9.0;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\3cf0187e\versions\node\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\cdc9e9bd\\versions\\node\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\cdc9e9bd\versions\node\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current;C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Oracle\Java\java8path;C:\Windows\system32;C:\Windows;C:\Windows\System32\Wbem;C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0;C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH;C:\Program Files\dotnet;D:\apps\java\jdk-21\bin;D:\apps\apache-maven-3.9.6\bin;D:\apps\mingw64\bin;C:\Program Files\Tailscale\;C:\Users\86150\.local\bin;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Programs\oh-my-posh\bin;D:\apps\nvm4w\nodejs;D:\apps\nvm;D:\apps\python312;D:\apps\python312\Scripts;D:\apps\Git\cmd;C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\;C:\Program Files\Go\bin;C:\Users\86150\.cargo\bin;C:\Users\86150\scoop\shims;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\pnpm;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Google.PlatformTools_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\platform-tools;D:\apps\nssm-2.24\win64
     =  -split ';'
     = @{}
     = @()
    
    foreach ( in ) {
         = .Trim().Replace('\\', '\').TrimEnd('\')
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace()) { continue }
        if (-not .ContainsKey(.ToLower())) {
            [.ToLower()] = True
             += 
        }
    }
    
    D:\\apps\\nvm\\v24.9.0;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\3cf0187e\\versions\\node\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current;D:\apps\nvm\v24.9.0;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\3cf0187e\versions\node\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\tools\\trae-gopls\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\workspaces\\cdc9e9bd\\versions\\node\\current;c:\\Users\\86150\\.trae-cn\\sdks\\versions\\node\\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\tools\trae-gopls\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\workspaces\cdc9e9bd\versions\node\current;c:\Users\86150\.trae-cn\sdks\versions\node\current;C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Oracle\Java\java8path;C:\Windows\system32;C:\Windows;C:\Windows\System32\Wbem;C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0;C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH;C:\Program Files\dotnet;D:\apps\java\jdk-21\bin;D:\apps\apache-maven-3.9.6\bin;D:\apps\mingw64\bin;C:\Program Files\Tailscale\;C:\Users\86150\.local\bin;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Programs\oh-my-posh\bin;D:\apps\nvm4w\nodejs;D:\apps\nvm;D:\apps\python312;D:\apps\python312\Scripts;D:\apps\Git\cmd;C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\;C:\Program Files\Go\bin;C:\Users\86150\.cargo\bin;C:\Users\86150\scoop\shims;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\pnpm;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps;C:\Users\86150\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Google.PlatformTools_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\platform-tools;D:\apps\nssm-2.24\win64 =  -join ';'
}
`

## Additional Context

- System PATH and User PATH are clean (no duplicates)
- Issue only occurs in Trae integrated terminal
- Multiple workspace IDs appear in paths: 3cf0187e, cdc9e9bd
- This started happening suddenly without Trae update
